text:
infra-bot: ALERT: KV-cache hit rate dropped below 50% for >2m across redis-cluster-prod (svc=runtime). Pager sent to #oncall. Link: https://ops.redwood.example/alerts/1789504321 :rotating_light:
alyssa: acked. jumping in. seeing elevated eviction_count and mem_pressure on 3/6 cache nodes. pulling logs now.
mike: thanks — are customers impacted or just background reruns?
alyssa: early sign is increased tail latency for small model requests (50-95th). customer error rates not spiking yet but some retries observed. putting a banner on status page while we triage. :white_flag:
priya: are these the requests hitting the small-seq partition? I can check model routing metrics.
alyssa: yes looks concentrated on small-seq keyspace, likely due to a bad traffic surge from a single tenant doing heavy prompt-churn.
samir: is autoscale for dedicated cache pools healthy? any OOMs?
alyssa: no OOMs, but eviction churn high -> lower hit rates. suspect working set outgrew LRU footprint after a recent A/B test increased per-request prefixes.
emma: copying the traces I see more cache-miss followed by cold KV fetches, leading to longer inference paths.
mike: mitigation idea: temporarily increase in-memory cache size for small-seq pool and enable prefix coalescing to reduce distinct keys. Can we do that safely?
alyssa: can roll config change on pool config: increase max_memory from 120g -> 160g, and flip coalescing flag on. Doing a canary on two nodes first.
infra-bot: deploy started: cache-config-v2 -> canary nodes n-12,n-14. CI job: deploy/1789504321.
alyssa: canary applied. monitoring: eviction_count stabilized on n-12 within 60s, hit-rate up ~12%. Prometheus shows latency tail improving.
priya: great. push to rest of nodes?
mike: recommend gradual rollout with a 10% step and watch evictions and mem pressure. Also we should tune alerting: current hit-rate alert fired on a 1m window — too noisy for transient spikes.
alyssa: Agreed. For post-incident: change the alert to trigger when hit_rate < 45% for >3m AND eviction_rate > 200/s to reduce false positives. Also add per-tenant anomaly so single-tenant churn won't page full SRE.
emma: logging note: add dimension tenant_id to kv_miss logs for 30d to enable root cause analysis.
samir: actions for now: 1) finish rollout 2) create runbook addendum for cache surge 3) tune alert 4) dashboard improvements (hit-rate per model + eviction heatmap)
alyssa: rolling to rest of nodes now.
infra-bot: deploy finished: cache-config-v2 -> all nodes (success).
alyssa: after full rollout hit-rate is back to baseline ~82%, evictions down 78%. Latency tail reduced ~140ms. Unsure about long-term cost of larger memory — need follow-up.
priya: I'll open a ticket to correlate the A/B test traffic with tenant X usage spike and propose rate-limits or token-bucket smoothing for that experiment.
mike: on alerts: here's the Prometheus alert rule I propose (to be deployed in ops-alerts):
```
- alert: KVCacheLowHitRateStable
  expr: (sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total[3m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_requests_total[3m]))) < 0.45
  for: 3m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "KV cache hit rate <45% for 3m and eviction > threshold"
```
Also add a companion alert that fires a warning (pager=false) for 1m windows so we still see short blips in dashboards.
emma: dashboard changes: I'll add panels: per-model hit_rate timeseries, eviction_rate heatmap by node, per-tenant miss ratio, and a derived metric: miss_cost_estimate (tokens * latency penalty) so product can estimate customer impact.
samir: we should also add an eviction_alert: when eviction_rate per-node > 300/s sustained for 2m send a page and include top-5 hot prefixes.
alyssa: agreed. I'll make the runbook edits now. Adding a step to check the 'recent deploys' and 'experimental routes' checklist before scaling memory.
mike: good. handoff: I'm on second half of shift starting in 10m — @alyssa can you summarize current state for me to pick up?
alyssa: summary for handoff -> mitigations applied: cache-config-v2 rolled, canary successful, hit-rate recovered to baseline, eviction rates reduced. Customer impact: minor tail latency increase for a subset of small-seq requests, no sustained error-rate spikes. Next steps: Priya to investigate tenant spike, Emma to deploy dashboards, Samir to add eviction alert, Mike to own follow-up alert tuning PR.
mike: thanks. I'll take it and follow up on the alert PR. Please post links to tickets and dashboards here when ready.
priya: creating ticket now: OPS-4121 with initial findings + tenant X correlation.
emma: dashboard draft URL: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/kv-cache-overview (will add panels and post link in OPS-4121).
samir: PR for eviction alert submitted: https://git.redwood.example/ops/alerts/pull/87
alyssa: runbook updated: https://confluence.redwood.example/pages/ops-kv-cache-runbook (added section 'surge from experiments' and 'temporary memory scale' with rollback steps).
mike: closing the page on my side. leaving note to revisit memory sizing in capacity planning meeting. thanks all. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: Incident 1789504321 marked resolved by alyssa. Duration: 8m  (alerts: kv-cache-hit-rate)
alyssa: nice work everyone. postmortem to follow after root cause confirmed.
priya: thanks — will add tenant quota proposals to postmortem.
